title: Public Alert No. 06/2025 – Alert on the Sale of Counterfeit Noristerat Injection 200mg in Nigeria
summary: NAFDAC warns that Chlorpheniramine and Dexamethasone injection ampoules are being mislabelled and repacked as Noristerat Injection 200mg, found in Niger, Bauchi and Kano (CWC) states. The counterfeiter has been arrested.
